# Oryx icon-semantic fixture

These crops come from a WGC capture of the local Oryx Desktop 0.19.1 Windows
build at native display scale on 2026-09-15. Labels describe the visible icon,
not the model prediction. `oryx-window-0.19.1.png` retains the real main
workspace while excluding the history sidebar, and presents deterministic UI
to the YOLO/OCR frozen-runtime smoke test and detector-parity benchmark.
Caption labels are historical research annotations; the current runtime returns
unnamed YOLO nodes for the main LLM to interpret in full-screenshot context.
